# Smithy — Design Notes

- **Source Reference**: ColorLib Schmidt (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/schmidt/`), preview URL: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/schmidt/`.
- **Aesthetic**: Clean, modern professional personal portfolio with blue accent (`#0d6efd`), dark text (`#212529`), and generous spacing.
- **Typography**: Poppins sans-serif font family loaded via Google Fonts.
- **Footer Requirement**: Must link `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").
- **Asset Handling**: All images use deterministic picsum placeholders (`https://picsum.photos/seed/smithy-...`).
